card.name: Science news words before research
card.fires_on: Nouns in science news and academic text where a research-related word could come next, such as authors, analysis, example, or experience. Also partway through institution names like National Academy of Engineering.

modes.description: Nouns about papers, authors, or findings in news reports.

modes.label: Limited or first evidence
modes.description: Nouns after limited, first, or new that describe prior work.

card.writes: It lowers the chance of the word research and similar words such as studies coming next.
card.plain: It marks spots in science writing where the word research might otherwise follow, and pushes against it.
